title: Nobody Uses Dryer NINE 🧺
description:
At the all-night laundromat, you never use dryer nine. It runs every night with nothing in it, and its timer doesn't count down to dry.

My big brother moves out at sunrise. Nine says forty-one minutes, and I'm not ready.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment QUARTER if you'd have fed it too.
